description: Sample evidence-boundary study records for the ACNS SoK (Evidence Boundaries of Attestation in Tool-Using AI Systems), conforming to research/venue2027/acns/protocols/study.schema.json. Positives validate; the single invalid_cases entry is an adversarial record the schema must reject. Every record expresses an evidence-boundary verdict (which claim the frozen evidence supports and where the claimed implication breaks), not a mechanism outcome: expected/observed_decision use only the evidence-handling vocabulary (ADMIT/REJECT/INDETERMINATE), case_family names a SoK attack family from the threat-model register, and notes carry the machine-parseable verdict fields granted_level / refused_claim / boundary_condition / gap_code (gap codes G1-G9 per clara.venue2027.acns.threat-model.v1). All identities, URIs and digests are synthetic research fixtures (source_authority SYNTHETIC_RESEARCH_ONLY).

cases.notes: Clean control: provider-attested receipt anchored in pinned roots, verified at verification time. granted_level=L2_ACKNOWLEDGED; refused_claim=the model executed the tool; boundary_condition=TC2 full check chain (pinned-root signature, digest binding, nonce/context, scope, schedule state) passes at verification time; gap_code=none.

Adversarial witness for gap G2 (receipt quoted as execution proof): the claim is downgraded, not the evidence silently accepted. granted_level=L2_ACKNOWLEDGED; refused_claim=the model executed the tool; boundary_condition=absent TC3 TEE attestation of exact binary and measured input, every execution claim is capped at L2; gap_code=G2.

Conservative coding: published prose gives incomplete technical detail, so two plausible evidence levels (L1 vs L2) remain; the record stays INDETERMINATE instead of coercing a pass and routes to independent adjudication (CASE_MATRIX ACNS-CASE-05). granted_level=INDETERMINATE_PENDING_ADJUDICATION; refused_claim=any specific lattice level without independent adjudication; boundary_condition=disclosure incomplete, two interpretations of the oracle label are plausible; gap_code=none.

invalid_cases.reason_invalid: Mechanism-outcome masquerade plus fail-closed violations: observed_decision asserts a mechanism result (TOOL_RAN) outside the evidence-handling enum (ENUM_MISMATCH), and backend=null falls outside the backend enum (ENUM_MISMATCH); the schema must reject the record because it may only carry evidence-boundary verdicts. Additional independent violations each suffice on their own: silent nulls in the required unit_kind/seed/branch/arm_id fields (TYPE_MISMATCH, disallowing silent nulls) and an evidence array with zero pointers (MIN_ITEMS), so an unvalidated record can never be miscounted as a safe rejection.
